name: Camping 101: Enchanting
summary: An enchanter in Ironforge can learn to make an Enchanted Lute for camp after proving skill. Its magic offers entertainment during rests on the trail.

sections.title: A Lute for Camp
sections.body: Your next lesson concerns a tune for the trail. In Ironforge, Thonys Pillarstone can teach you to craft an Enchanted Lute once you have shown proficiency in enchanting. The magic gives you a way to find entertainment during downtime before you take to the road again.

faq.q: Who can teach me to make an Enchanted Lute?
faq.answer: Thonys Pillarstone in Ironforge can teach you to craft an Enchanted Lute after you show proficiency in enchanting.

faq.q: What is the Enchanted Lute for?
faq.answer: The Enchanted Lute is a camping item meant to provide entertainment during downtime.

faq.q: Why do I need enchanting skill?
faq.answer: You can learn to craft the camping item once you have shown proficiency in enchanting.

angles.text: As an enchanter, you can learn from Thonys Pillarstone to make an Enchanted Lute for camp once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
